verdict.rationale: ReadMe's first-party docs state that developers can make test calls directly from the API reference and see real responses without writing code. The docs also describe interactive documentation generated from an OAS upload, and injecting users' API keys and server variables into the hub. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of playground mechanics (auth configuration, CORS/proxy handling, supported request types), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the try-it calls work against live APIs.
